Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.password

Interface UserAccountRepository

public interface UserAccountRepository
Port that provides the user accounts able to sign in with a password. An implementation never returns null and never lets a framework or storage type escape through it.

    • markEmailVerified

      boolean markEmailVerified(UUID userId)
      Marks the e-mail address of an account as verified and enables the account, but only while the address is still unverified: the transition happens once, so a replayed verification never re-enables an account that was disabled after its address had been verified.
      Parameters:
      userId - identifier of the account.
      Returns:
      true when the address was unverified and is now verified, false when the account does not exist or its address had already been verified (nothing changes then).
